Guard Unilda Tiro is a human guard in Baldur's Gate.
“
I told you already, no access to the printer room. If you keep forgetting, I'll print it out and nail it to yer head. Sod off.
„
— Unilda Tiro

Involvement

Unilda can be found stationed near the stairs down to the basement in the Baldur's Mouth in the Lower City at X: 48 Y: -61.
